A significant interactive two-locus model of STX1A_rs4363087|VAMP2_rs2278637 (presynaptic genes) was observed among SVC variants in all epilepsy cases (P 1000-value = 0.054; CVC = 9/10; OR = 2.86, 95%CI = 1.88-4.35).

A significant interactive two-locus model of STX1A_rs4363087|VAMP2_rs2278637 (presynaptic genes) was observed among SVC variants in all epilepsy cases (P 1000-value = 0.054; CVC = 9/10; OR = 2.86, 95%CI = 1.88-4.35). Further, subgroup analysis revealed stronger interaction for the same model in cryptogenic epilepsy patients only (P 1000-value = 0.012; CVC = 10/10; OR = 4.59, 95%CI = 2.57-8.22).
